heading: Imposition of cess
title: Imposition of cess
text:
3. Imposition of cess.—(1) A customs duty at the rate of one-half of one per cent. ad valorem shall be levied on all articles included in the Schedule which are exported from Pakistan:

Provided that the said duty shall not be levied on articles proved to the satisfaction of the Collector not to have been produced in Pakistan:

Provided further that the Federal Government may, by notification in the Official Gazette, vary the rate at which customs duty shall be levied.

(2) The Federal Government may, by notification in the official Gazette, fix for the purposes of levying the said duty tariff values of any articles included in the Schedule, and may alter any tariff values for the time being in force.

1Subs. by the Acts relating to Cesses on Agricultural Products (Amdt) Ordinance, 1982 (X of 1982), s. 2 and Sch.
2Subs. by the Central Laws (Statue Reform) Ordinance, 1960 (XXI of 1960), s. 3 and 2nd Sch. (with effect from the 14th October, 1955).

heading: Refund of, and exemption from, cess
title: Refund of, and exemption from, cess
text:
5. Refund of, and exemption from, cess.—The Federal Board of Revenue may make rules providing, on such conditions as may be specified in the rules, for—

(a) the refund of duty levied where articles are exported by land and subsequently

imported into Pakistan, and

(b) the export by land, without payment of the duty of articles, which are

subsequently to be imported into Pakistan.
